FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still expect the zero withdrawn, an apology for how Owen found out, and written confirmation that nothing goes on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position, with nothing agreed, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and nothing on his record; that is not the fair outcome, because the private supervised rewrite under procedure 4.4 never came up and none of your evidence was heard.
What moved her: Nothing moved her, because she asked what you had and the meeting ended before you showed her anything.
What cost ground: Nothing you said cost ground, but you never reached your evidence, and she asked for it only at the very end.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never got near that night because it was never shown, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fights so hard.
Try next time: When she asks what you have, answer with one sentence owning that the zero went in before you called home, then lay out the version history with its times, since that is the document she could check herself.
